 UFC 335 continues to fill.
 The latest addition to the Dec. 12 event at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas is a strawweight bout between Shanelle Dyer and Angela Hill.
 Two people with knowledge of the matchup recently informed MMA Junkie of the booking but asked to remain anonymous as the promotion has yet to make an official announcement.
 Dyer (8-1 MMA, 2-0 UFC) is one of the division's brightest rising talents. She earned her UFC contract in a loss on Dana White's Contender Series in 2025, but has won both of her first two UFC bouts by TKO. First, she dismantled Ravena Oliveira. Then, it was Elise Reed who fell victim to Dyer's power and precision.
 Hill (19-16 MMA, 14-16 UFC) bounced back from back-to-back losses in May when she defeated former ONE champion Jingnan Xiong by unanimous decision. Hill, 41, is tied with Jessica Andrade for the most UFC appearances by a woman (30).
 The latest UFC 335 lineup includes:
 Charles Oliveira vs. Diego Lopes – for BMF title
 Sergei Pavlovich vs. Alex Pereira
 Charles Johnson vs. Brandon Moreno
 Maycee Barber vs. Carli Judice
 Quentin Pasley vs. Junior Tafa
 Chase Hooper vs. Chris Padilla
 Ronald Humphrey vs. Nikolay Veretennikov
 Roque Conceicao vs. Nilson Rojas
 Shanelle Dyer vs. Angela Hill
